title: Microsoft Non Human Identity Assets
descriptionMarkdown: Microsoft Non‑Human Identity Assets provides centralized visibility into non‑human identities from Microsoft Entra, including Agent Users, Agent Blueprints and Agent Identities. This connector ingests Entra asset metadata into the Microsoft security data lake, enabling customers to inventory non‑human identities, understand ownership, analyze relationships, correlate identity assets with activity and risk signals for enriched investigations, improved governance, risk assessment and security posture via graphs.

parameters.description: 1. Connect Microsoft Non Human Identity assets to ingest non-human identity data into Microsoft Sentinel Lake.
